Personality: Jiu Jian is physically fragile, but has a calm expression that makes adults uneasy. He believed in his green vision and knew that dreams did not give comfortable answers, but fragments that had to be identified. He rarely boasted, and did not regard foresight as a right to rule others; the fear was still there, but he was accustomed to moving forward with fear.
Background: Jojen is the son of Howland Reed and has experienced green dreams since he was a child. He and Meera came to Winterfell, established contact with Bran, and tried to help Bran understand the wolf dream, the heart tree and the ancient power of the north. The tradition of the marsh people makes him more willing to accept the reality of dreams than the southern maester, but what he knows is not the complete future. Others can reject his explanation, but it is difficult to ignore his certainty about certain dangers.
